proposal.quote: A blue book is to be published next week of the Anglo-French-Russian negotiations at Moscow giving the full story of the breakdown.
proposal.rule: claude backend: The Anglo-Soviet alliance flag stays False when the 1939 talks failed, and the passage refers to the breakdown of the Anglo-French-Russian negotiations at Moscow.

proposal.quote: Deliveries of the oil and fodder previously agreed upon are under way.
proposal.rule: claude backend: Secured requires an overland supply agreement in force with a producer outside the blockade; the passage reports Soviet oil deliveries to Germany under a prior agreement already under way.

proposal.quote: up to the present Soviet military supplies to China have been continuing ... Japan has for some time been desirous of transferring the troops along the Siberian border for use in China
proposal.rule: claude backend: The china_war rule requires Japan's army to be engaged in a general war in China; the passage reports continuing military supplies to China and Japan's wish to move more troops there, which implies an ongoing war, though it does not state this outright.

proposal.quote: a committee of representatives of the Treasury, War and Navy Departments has now been established as the agency through which the Anglo-French Purchasing Board might deal with the United States Government
proposal.rule: claude backend: The wary level requires arms sold to belligerents; a US committee including the War and Navy Departments set up to deal with the Anglo-French Purchasing Board suggests such sales, but the text does not state that the embargo is repealed or that arms are being sold.

proposal.quote: Great Britain who now has her hands full in the west ... the Japanese Government is frankly favorable to the Allied cause in the present European war
